title: CoreyGames.net
description: A new type of Minecraft Server. Play Survival SMP, Hardcore, Creative, Gun City, and Minigames! Livestreamed Daily with Voice Chat and VR Support!
body:
Corey Games is a Minecraft network streamed live on YouTube & Twitch, with Voice Chat and VR supported!

Send 300+ commands from Discord at discord.gg/coreygames﻿

Modes:
Survival SMP — Explore, build and trade in a shared block economy!
Hardcore — Survival but No claims, a 2x sell bonus, and a 1-hour mode ban if you die!
Creative Plots — Build, then sell to the highest bidder!
Command Survival — Use chat commands to beat the game with the livestream!
Disaster City — Fight with guns in a fully destructible city with block physics!
NPC Arena — Spawn armies and battle with chat commands in a PVP arena!
Minigames — Sky Wars, Block Party, Spleef, Boat Racing & 10+ more!

Other features: Stock Trading, Bounty Hunting, Hub Parkour, Hub PVP, Present Hunting, Dodgeball, Soccer & more!

Updated daily, see you there!
